title: Opus 5.5 + Three.js + Tesana recreates Dark Fantasy game to perfection
author: Jonesiller5383
selftext:
The whole thing was built with 1 image reference + Opus 5.5 + Three.js + Tesana.

The prompt was literally "Create a Dark Fantasy RPG based on the image reference, which was from one of those viral tiktok videos"

It took 22 minutes to generate and cost $10. The game has a couple of quest, a quest line tied to the world (it's covered in darkness), some wolfs, you need to light all brazers to open the castle gate, that actually opens up with a smooth animation.

After killing the boss, the entire valley gets it sunlight back. I have now sent a new mega prompt added crazy amount of depth into the game, will update you all the progress.

We’re getting to a point where you can have an idea for a game, give an AI a visual direction, and actually end up with something you can play. I remember this being an extremely viral video trend last couple of years with endless thousands comments of people wishing they could play something like this.

Now you can just... make it. This stuff is getting insane.
